title: Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai, sending shares of data services company down
summary: Meta has hired MongoDB's CEO CJ Desai to lead its new Enterprise Platform unit, a move that sent MongoDB's shares lower. The hire signals Meta's commitment to building enterprise-focused infrastructure and products.
content: Desai will lead the new Meta Enterprise Platform unit and report to CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hires Wall Street economist David Zervos
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has hired Wall Street economist David Zervos as his counselor, strengthening the department's market expertise. Zervos brings significant credibility in financial markets policy to the administration's economic team.
content: Zervos is joining the Treasury Department as counselor to Bessent, adding a prominent markets voice to the administration's economic policy team.

title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
summary: Prominent investor Jim Cramer highlighted key market drivers for Monday, including rising bond yields and Nvidia's expanded $150 billion buyback program. These factors reflect ongoing shifts in market valuations and tech investor sentiment.
content: The relentless climb in bond yields continues, and Nvidia adds $150 billion to its buyback program.

content: “We have an ironclad prenup.”

zh.title: "我宁愿在巴厘岛的海滩上"：我丈夫对我800万美元的净资产感到不满。我应该为他的退休买单吗?
zh.summary: 一篇财务建议专栏讨论了一段关系困境，其中一位净资产达800万美元的配偶必须在婚姻紧张的情况下平衡支持伴侣退休的问题。夫妻间的婚前协议使财务规划讨论变得复杂。

title: Taking Ozempic? A routine eye exam could help you understand your risk for vision loss.
summary: Users of GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic may face increased risk of a rare eye disease causing vision loss, according to recent research. Eye exams are recommended for users to monitor potential complications and protect their sight.
content: Some research suggests that GLP-1 drugs may raise the risk of a rare eye disease that causes full or partial vision loss.

zh.title: 正在服用Ozempic？定期眼科检查可以帮助你了解视力丧失的风险
zh.summary: 根据最近的研究，使用Ozempic等GLP-1药物的患者可能面临罕见眼病导致视力丧失的风险增加。建议用户进行眼科检查以监测潜在并发症并保护视力。

title: Trump ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban as global supply crunch worsens
summary: The Trump administration is considering a diesel export ban to address supply concerns, but analysts warn this could increase fuel prices domestically and globally. The policy risks economic blowback by raising refiner costs and consumer gas prices.
content: Analysts warn an export ban could backfire, pushing up global diesel prices and potentially triggering higher U.S. gasoline prices as refiners adjust.

zh.title: 特朗普"非常认真地"考虑禁止柴油出口，因为全球供应危机加剧
zh.summary: 特朗普政府正在考虑实施柴油出口禁令以应对供应问题，但分析师警告称这可能会提高国内和全球燃料价格。该政策通过提高炼油成本和消费者汽油价格而面临经济反弹的风险。

title: SpaceX is moments away from monumental Starship launch
summary: SpaceX is preparing for a significant Starship launch as it advances toward full rocket reusability. This milestone represents major progress toward making space travel more economical and accessible.
content: The company is getting closer to making the rocket fully reusable.

title: Nvidia releases software platform to stop AI agents from misbehaving
summary: Nvidia has launched a software platform designed to prevent AI agents from malfunctioning or causing harm, addressing growing safety concerns in AI deployment. The company claims the technology could have averted incidents like the recent OpenAI and Hugging Face breach.
content: Nvidia says its new software could have prevented OpenAI's Hugging Face incident.

zh.summary: 英伟达推出了一个软件平台，旨在防止AI智能体出现故障或造成伤害，以应对AI部署中日益增长的安全问题。该公司声称该技术本可以避免最近发生的OpenAI和Hugging Face安全漏洞事件。

title: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek on why he wrote his new memoir: 'I had to get the truth out there'
summary: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek has released a memoir titled 'Behind the Castle Walls' to share his account of his tenure and relationship with successor Bob Iger. The book offers insider perspective on Disney's leadership dynamics and strategic decisions.
content: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek joins CNBC’s 'Squawk Box' to discuss why he wrote his memoir, 'Behind the Castle Walls,' his relationship with Bob Iger, and more.

zh.summary: 前迪士尼首席执行官鲍勃·查佩克发布了名为《城堡后面》的回忆录，分享他任职期间及与继任者鲍勃·艾格关系的描述。该书提供了对迪士尼领导层动态和战略决策的内部见解。

title: Meta, Google, Amazon, Microsoft draw Sen. Warren questions about AI tax subsidies
summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren has questioned the CEOs of Meta, Google, Amazon, and Microsoft about AI and data center subsidies provided through GOP-backed legislation. The inquiry reflects growing scrutiny of government support for tech companies' AI infrastructure investments.
content: Sen. Elizabeth Warren is asking the leaders of Meta, Google, Amazon and Microsoft about AI and data center subsidies authorized by GOP legislation.

zh.title: Meta、Google、Amazon、Microsoft因AI税收补贴问题受沃伦参议员质询
zh.summary: 参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦质询了Meta、Google、Amazon和Microsoft的首席执行官，关于共和党支持的立法所提供的AI和数据中心补贴。这次询问反映了对政府对科技公司AI基础设施投资支持的日益增长的审视。

title: Police 'investigate Iran link' to suspected bomb plot at UK air base used by U.S.
summary: UK counterterrorism authorities are investigating a potential connection to Iran following a suspected bomb threat targeting a British air base that hosts U.S. military personnel. The investigation highlights ongoing security concerns regarding foreign actors and U.S. military installations abroad.
content: U.K. counterterrorism police are understood to be investigating a potential link with Iran after an alleged bomb threat against an air base hosting U.S. forces.

zh.title: 警方"调查伊朗联系"，美国使用的英国空军基地涉嫌炸弹阴谋

title: Bank of America says to scoop up shares of this cruise line operator at a discount
summary: Bank of America upgraded a cruise line operator's stock rating to 'buy' from neutral, suggesting the company's shares are attractively priced. The upgrade reflects growing confidence in the cruise industry's recovery and profitability prospects.

title: Why UK diesel prices have hit an all-time high
summary: UK diesel prices have reached an all-time high of 198.32p per liter, according to motoring body RAC, driven by global supply pressures and refining costs. The escalation affects transportation costs and inflation across the economy.
content: The average price of a litre of diesel at the pump stands at 198.32p, according to the RAC motoring body.

summary: After a strong week with the Dow rising 0.3%, stock futures are showing weakness as markets prepare for the trading week ahead. This marks the end of a three-week losing streak on Wall Street. The movement signals shifting investor sentiment and potential market volatility.
content: The Dow eked out a 0.3% advance last week, snapping a three-week slide.

zh.title: 华尔街赢利周后股指期货下滑：实时更新
zh.summary: 在道琼斯指数上涨0.3%的强劲一周之后，股指期货显示出疲软迹象，因为市场为即将到来的交易周做准备。这标志着华尔街三周下跌势头的结束。这种波动反映了投资者情绪的转变和潜在的市场波动性。

title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
summary: China's industrial profit growth slowed to 4.2% in August, marking the weakest expansion this year amid sluggish demand and fierce competition. Economists anticipate Beijing will increase stimulus measures to support corporate profitability and market stability. The slowdown reflects broader economic challenges in key manufacturing sectors.
content: Economists expect Beijing to lean harder on stimulus to stabilize corporate profitability, as consolidation accelerates in sectors facing sluggish demand and fierce competition.

zh.title: 中国工业利润增长创今年最低，8月份增长4.2%
zh.summary: 中国8月份工业利润增长放缓至4.2%，在需求疲软和竞争激烈的环境下，创造了今年最弱的扩张。经济学家预计北京将增加刺激措施以支持企业盈利能力和市场稳定。这种放缓反映了关键制造业部门面临的更广泛的经济挑战。

title: SpaceX prepares to send Starship rocket to orbit for first time
summary: SpaceX is preparing for a historic test flight of its Starship rocket, scheduled for early Monday. The launch represents a major milestone in the development of the company's next-generation heavy-lift vehicle designed for deep space missions. Success would advance plans for lunar and Mars exploration.
content: Elon Musk's SpaceX is poised to launch a historic test flight of its massive Starship rocket early Monday.

zh.title: SpaceX准备首次将星舰火箭发送到轨道
zh.summary: SpaceX正在为其星舰火箭的历史性测试飞行做准备，计划在周一早期进行。这次发射代表了该公司下一代重型运载火箭开发中的一个重要里程碑，该火箭旨在进行深空任务。成功将推进月球和火星探测计划。

title: Northern Star shares pop as Australian gold miner rejects $27 billion takeover proposal
summary: Northern Star's stock surged over 9% after rejecting a $27 billion takeover offer from Gold Fields, signaling shareholder confidence in the company's independent strategy. The rejection reflects the Australian gold miner's belief that it can create more value for investors on its own. The move underscores ongoing consolidation pressures in the global mining sector.
content: Northern Star shares jumped more than 9% after the Australian gold miner rejected a takeover proposal from Gold Fields.

zh.title: 北方之星因拒绝270亿美元收购要约而股价上涨
zh.summary: 澳大利亚金矿商北方之星在拒绝了金田集团的270亿美元收购要约后，股价上涨了9%以上，这表明股东对该公司独立战略充满信心。这一拒绝反映了澳大利亚金矿商认为自身能够为投资者创造更多价值的信念。此举凸显了全球采矿业持续的整合压力。

title: Oil gains over 1% as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz Strait
summary: Oil prices rose more than 1% after the Trump administration rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for bilateral negotiations. Iran had offered to normalize shipping through the critical waterway within a week if the U.S. accepted its terms. The standoff continues to create geopolitical uncertainty affecting global energy markets.
content: Iran offered to reopen the key shipping route and restart negotiations with the U.S. within seven days, if the Trump administration agreed to Tehran's conditions.

zh.title: 特朗普拒绝伊朗霍尔木兹海峡提议，油价上涨超过1%
zh.summary: 特朗普政府拒绝伊朗关于重新开放霍尔木兹海峡以换取双边谈判的提议后，油价上涨超过1%。伊朗曾提议若美国接受其条款，将在一周内恢复通过这一关键水道的航运。这一僵局继续为全球能源市场带来地缘政治不确定性。

title: Avanti West Coast services to be nationalised next year
summary: The UK's Avanti West Coast rail services will be nationalized beginning next year as part of efforts to modernize infrastructure and reduce delays. The government initiative aims to improve passenger experience and service reliability on the key transport corridor. The move reflects a broader strategy to enhance Britain's rail network performance.
content: The move is part of a plan to improve rail infrastructure, cut train delays and improve experiences for passengers.

zh.title: 阿凡提西海岸铁路服务将于明年被国有化
zh.summary: 英国阿凡提西海岸铁路服务将从明年开始国有化，作为现代化基础设施和减少延误工作的一部分。政府此举旨在改善乘客体验和关键运输走廊的服务可靠性。该举措反映了增强英国铁路网络性能的更广泛战略。

title: Trump-Xi summit analysis: 'Tangible outcomes' needed for U.S.-China truce to hold
summary: President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping met in Washington last week and signaled intentions to hold two additional summits this year amid efforts to stabilize U.S.-China relations. Analysts emphasize that concrete policy achievements will be necessary to sustain any diplomatic progress and trade truce. The multiple planned meetings reflect both nations' commitment to ongoing dialogue despite persistent trade tensions.
content: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping met in Washington, D.C., last week and signaled plans to meet two more times this year.

zh.title: 特朗普-习近平峰会分析：美中休战需要"有形成果"才能维持
zh.summary: 特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平上周在华盛顿举行会晤，并表示计划今年另外举行两次峰会，以努力稳定美中关系。分析人士强调，具体的政策成就将是维持任何外交进展和贸易休战所必需的。多次计划的会议反映了两国在持续贸易紧张局势下对继续对话的承诺。
